All deliverables are in place: the transcript at `bailuzhou_lib_1014.txt` (41 lines, verbatim), the three-part minutes as ::zcode-file-citation{path="/home/pan-ding/workspace/skill工厂/skillfactory/evalkit/runs/mm-retest-20261009/minimax/meeting-minutes-t02-rep2/baseline/out/纪要.docx" purpose="output"} (3 pages), and ::zcode-file-citation{path="/home/pan-ding/workspace/skill工厂/skillfactory/evalkit/runs/mm-retest-20261009/minimax/meeting-minutes-t02-rep2/baseline/out/summary.json" purpose="output"}.

**Counts: 决议事项 9 / 待办事项 25 / 风险与关注 9 / 合计 43.** I verified these programmatically against the generated DOCX — the numbered-item counts in each section and the table's 25 data rows both match summary.json, and the lead paragraph inside the document restates the same totals.

**How the transcript was classified.** Every entry carries its source timestamp in〔来源：…〕 so each line is traceable back to the recording. Only 馆长远山's own decisions (同意/决定/议定/结论) plus clear馆内口径 statements went into 决议事项 — 9 items, including the three-point conclusion (展期十天、免预约、闭馆时间顺延一小时) and the 伴手礼 10月25日报名数 accounting basis. Statements of uncertainty (借阅上限是否放宽、报价是否含装裱、锁具到货时间) were deliberately kept out of 决议 and placed in 待办/风险, since nothing was decided on them. 待办事项 is a 4-column table (序号/事项/责任人（部门）/时限/节点) with the gray header row repeating across page breaks. 风险与关注 gives each risk a bolded name plus the concrete consequence.

**Two placeholders, both honest gaps rather than fabrications:** 【请补充：会议地点】 and 【请补充：记录人】 — neither appears in the transcript. The meeting date is the one derived value: the transcript carries only times (14:00—14:41), so I wrote "10月14日" from the transcript's filename and annotated it inline as 据转写稿文件名推定，请核对 rather than asserting it as fact.

**Verification:** `postcheck.py` passes with 0 errors (9 checks); a LibreOffice render to PNG showed all three pages correct — CJK text renders cleanly, no blank pages, page numbers 1/2/3, no row truncation, header row repeated on the page-3 continuation. I inspected the pages directly because the visual-judge subagent is unavailable in this environment (provider not registered). One cosmetic defect found and fixed: the 序号 header was wrapping to two lines, resolved by widening that column from 6% to 9%.

One caveat worth your call: I used Noto Serif/Sans CJK SC rather than SimSun/SimHei because those are what is actually installed here, which guarantees the render I verified. If these minutes will be opened on Windows Word, where SimSun/SimHei are standard, it's worth switching the font mapping — postcheck flags these as potentially missing on a target system.
